faqs.question: How do I get started with DoQshare?
faqs.answer: Getting started is simple! Sign up for a free account, upload your first document, and create a secure link to share. No credit card required. You can start sharing and tracking documents in minutes.

faqs.question: What file types are supported?
faqs.answer: DoQshare supports PDFs, Word documents (.docx, .doc), PowerPoint presentations (.pptx, .ppt), Excel spreadsheets, images, and more. Files are automatically optimized for secure sharing while maintaining quality.

faqs.question: How does document tracking work?
faqs.answer: DoQshare provides page-by-page analytics showing who viewed your documents, which pages they spent time on, when they accessed them, and for how long. You get real-time notifications and detailed insights to understand engagement patterns.

faqs.question: Can I control who views my documents?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can set passwords, expiration dates, require email verification, and control download permissions. You can also revoke access instantly at any time, even after sharing the link.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes! DoQshare uses bank-level AES-256 encryption for all documents. We're GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC2 compliant. Your documents are encrypted both in transit and at rest with zero-knowledge architecture, meaning we cannot access your document content.

faqs.question: Can I use my own domain?
faqs.answer: Yes! Business and Enterprise plans include custom domain support, allowing you to share documents using your own branded domain. You can also customize branding, logos, and colors for a professional appearance.

faqs.question: How much does DoQshare cost?
faqs.answer: DoQshare offers a free plan to get started. Paid plans start at $29/month for Pro, $79/month for Business, and $199/month for Data Rooms. All plans include a 14-day free trial. Enterprise plans are available with custom pricing.

faqs.question: Can I update my documents without changing the link?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can update your documents without changing the link. This means you can send one link to viewers and update it as your content evolves, keeping all stakeholders informed with the latest version.

faq1_security.title: Frequently asked questions

faqs.question: How is my data encrypted?
faqs.answer: DoQshare uses AES-256 encryption at rest, the same standard used by banks and government institutions. All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted using TLS 1.2+. We also implement zero-knowledge architecture, meaning we cannot access your document content even with administrative privileges.

faqs.question: Where is DoQshare hosted?
faqs.answer: DoQshare is hosted on enterprise-grade infrastructure with multiple region options. We offer GDPR-compliant hosting in the EU region, US region hosting, and access to 38+ global data center locations. Enterprise customers can choose their preferred hosting region for data residency requirements.

faqs.question: Can I control who can view my documents?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! DoQshare provides granular security permissions at file and folder levels. You can set allow and block lists, control document versions, apply dynamic watermarks, control downloads, require NDAs, and set password protection. You can also restrict access to specific email addresses or domains.

faqs.question: What audit data do you capture?
faqs.answer: DoQshare captures comprehensive audit trails including real-time notifications, page-by-page analytics, viewer identification (email, location, device, browser), document access logs, download tracking, and export capabilities. All interactions are logged for compliance and reporting purposes.

faqs.question: What is the difference between using DoQshare (SaaS) and self-hosting?
faqs.answer: DoQshare is available as both SaaS and open-source for self-hosting. The SaaS version provides managed infrastructure, automatic updates, and support. Self-hosting gives you complete control over your data and infrastructure, perfect for organizations with strict data residency requirements.

faqs.question: Do you support SSO and enterprise controls?
faqs.answer: Yes! DoQshare supports enterprise single sign-on (SSO) with SAML integration. We also offer advanced enterprise features including organization-wide allow/deny lists, team collaboration, permission inheritance, white-labeling, and dedicated support with guaranteed response times.

faqs.question: Are you SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes! DoQshare has achieved SOC 2 Type II certification, demonstrating our commitment to security, availability, and confidentiality. We are fully GDPR compliant for European customers and CCPA compliant for California residents. We also support HIPAA compliance for healthcare organizations.

faqs.question: Can I require an NDA before access?
faqs.answer: Yes! DoQshare offers NDA gate functionality that requires viewers to accept NDAs and agreements before accessing sensitive documents. All NDA acceptances are recorded with auditable records, providing legal protection and compliance documentation.

faqs.question: What is page-by-page analytics?
faqs.answer: Page-by-page analytics tracks viewer engagement at the individual page level. You can see which pages viewers spend the most time on, which pages they skip, and how they navigate through your documents. This helps you understand what content resonates most with your audience.

faqs.question: How does dynamic watermarking work?
faqs.answer: Dynamic watermarking automatically adds personalized watermarks to each document view, displaying the viewer's name, email, and timestamp. This prevents unauthorized sharing and helps identify the source of any leaks. Watermarks are applied in real-time and cannot be removed by viewers.

faqs.question: What is granular access control?
faqs.answer: Granular access control lets you set specific permissions for each viewer. You can control who can view, download, print, or share documents. You can also set expiration dates, require passwords, and revoke access instantly. This gives you complete control over your document security.

faqs.question: What is a virtual data room?
faqs.answer: A virtual data room is a secure online repository for sharing sensitive documents during M&A transactions, fundraising, due diligence, or other confidential processes. DoQshare's data rooms include advanced features like Q&A modules, complete audit trails, and granular permissions for managing complex deals.

faqs.question: How does screenshot protection work?
faqs.answer: Screenshot protection prevents viewers from taking screenshots or recording their screen while viewing documents. This is enforced at the browser level and helps protect your sensitive content from being captured and shared without permission.

faqs.question: What is the AI Document Assistant?
faqs.answer: The AI Document Assistant allows you to chat with your documents and data rooms using large language models. You can ask questions about document content, get instant answers, and extract insights from your documents without manually searching through them.

faqs.question: Can I customize the branding of my shared documents?
faqs.answer: Yes! Business and Enterprise plans include custom domain support and white-labeling options. You can use your own domain, customize colors, logos, and branding to make DoQshare feel native to your brand. Your viewers will see your branding, not ours.

faqs.question: What is document analytics?
faqs.answer: Document analytics provides detailed insights into how your documents are being viewed, shared, and engaged with. You can track page views, time spent on each page, viewer information, geographic data, and more to understand document performance and optimize your content strategy.

faqs.question: How do I track document views?
faqs.answer: Document tracking is automatic once you share a document link through DoQshare. Every view, page access, and interaction is automatically recorded. You can access analytics through your dashboard, where you'll see real-time data on all your shared documents.

faqs.question: What information can I track?
faqs.answer: You can track page-by-page views, time spent on each page, viewer identification (email, name, organization), geographic location (country and city), device type, operating system, browser information, download status, NDA signing, and session duration. All data is available in real-time through your analytics dashboard.

faqs.question: Is the analytics data real-time?
faqs.answer: Yes! DoQshare provides real-time analytics updates. You can see viewer activity as it happens, receive instant notifications when documents are viewed, and monitor document performance in real-time through your dashboard.

faqs.question: Is viewer privacy protected?
faqs.answer: Yes. While we track analytics data to help you understand document engagement, we respect viewer privacy. Viewers are identified by email when they access documents, but we comply with all privacy regulations including GDPR and CCPA. You can configure privacy settings based on your requirements.

faqs.question: How do I enable analytics?
faqs.answer: Analytics are automatically enabled for all shared documents. Simply share a document link through DoQshare, and analytics tracking begins immediately. No additional setup or configuration is required. You can access analytics through your dashboard at any time.

faqs.question: Which plan includes analytics?
faqs.answer: All DoQshare plans include analytics features. The free plan includes basic analytics, while Pro, Business, and Data Rooms plans include advanced analytics with more detailed insights, export capabilities, and longer data retention periods.

faqs.question: Can I export analytics data?
faqs.answer: Yes! Business and Data Rooms plans include export capabilities. You can export analytics data in CSV format for further analysis, reporting, or integration with other tools. Export includes all tracked metrics including views, time spent, viewer information, and geographic data.

faqs.question: What is a virtual data room?
faqs.answer: A virtual data room (VDR) is a secure online repository for storing and sharing confidential documents during business transactions like M&A, fundraising, due diligence, and investment rounds. DoQshare provides enterprise-grade security with advanced analytics for complete control over your sensitive documents.

faqs.question: How secure is DoQshare's data room?
faqs.answer: DoQshare uses bank-level AES-256 encryption for all documents. We're GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC2 compliant, ensuring your sensitive documents meet the highest security standards. All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest with zero-knowledge architecture.

faqs.question: Can I track who viewed documents in my data room?
faqs.answer: Yes! DoQshare provides detailed analytics including who viewed your documents, which pages they spent time on, when they accessed them, and for how long. You get page-by-page insights to understand engagement patterns during due diligence.

faqs.question: How many data rooms can I create?
faqs.answer: With DoQshare, you can create unlimited data rooms. Each data room can be customized with its own branding, permissions, and access controls. Perfect for managing multiple deals, fundraising rounds, or due diligence processes simultaneously.

faqs.question: Can I control access to specific documents in my data room?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. DoQshare offers granular permissions allowing you to control who can view, download, and print specific documents. You can set expiration dates, require passwords, and revoke access instantly for any user or group.

faqs.question: What file types are supported in data rooms?
faqs.answer: DoQshare supports PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, Excel spreadsheets, images, and more. Files are automatically optimized for secure sharing while maintaining quality. Large files and bulk uploads are fully supported.

faqs.question: Can I use my own domain for my data room?
faqs.answer: Yes! Enterprise and Business plans include custom domain support, allowing you to share your data room using your own branded domain for a professional appearance that matches your company branding.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial for data rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all data room features. No credit card required. You can start creating and sharing data rooms immediately to test all functionality.

faqs.question: What is DoQshare Enterprise?
faqs.answer: DoQshare Enterprise is our advanced solution designed for large organizations that need enhanced security, compliance, and administrative controls. It includes features like SSO integration, advanced analytics, white-labeling, self-hosted deployment options, and dedicated support.

faqs.question: How is Enterprise different from the cloud version?
faqs.answer: Enterprise includes advanced features like SSO integration, custom branding, priority support, dedicated account management, and enhanced security controls. It also offers self-hosted deployment options for organizations that need complete control over their data and infrastructure. Enterprise plans include unlimited data rooms, storage, and viewers.

faqs.question: Can we customize the security settings?
faqs.answer: Yes, Enterprise customers have access to advanced security configurations including custom password policies, IP restrictions, session management, and comprehensive audit logging. Self-hosted customers have complete control over all security settings and can implement custom security policies tailored to their requirements.

faqs.question: Do you offer deployment support?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive deployment support for both cloud and self-hosted Enterprise customers. This includes migration assistance, configuration guidance, Docker deployment support, on-premises installation assistance, and training for your team.

faqs.question: What kind of support is included?
faqs.answer: Enterprise customers receive priority support with dedicated account managers, 24/7 phone support, and faster response times. Self-hosted customers also get deployment support, ongoing maintenance assistance, and access to source code licenses for internal customization.

faqs.question: Can we get a custom SLA?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer custom Service Level Agreements for Enterprise customers based on your specific requirements. This includes uptime guarantees (typically 99.9% or higher), response times, performance metrics, and tailored support agreements to meet your organization's needs.

faqs.question: What is included in self-hosted deployment?
faqs.answer: Self-hosted Enterprise includes Docker compatibility for easy deployment, license to source code for internal customization, on-premises installation support, full control over your data and infrastructure, and the ability to deploy on your own servers or private cloud environment.

faqs.question: How does white-labeling work?
faqs.answer: White-labeling allows you to fully customize the DoQshare interface with your own branding. This includes custom domain support, logo replacement, color schemes, email templates, and complete interface customization. Your users will see your brand, not ours, creating a seamless experience.

list.question: How can DoQshare help with my fundraising?
list.answer: DoQshare helps you track investor engagement with your pitch deck in real-time. See which investors viewed your deck, which slides they spent time on, and use these insights to prioritize follow-ups and optimize your pitch. Many founders use this data to close deals faster by understanding what resonates with investors.

list.question: Can I see which slides investors spend the most time on?

list.question: Is my pitch deck secure?
list.answer: Absolutely. DoQshare uses bank-level AES-256 encryption for all documents. We're GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC2 compliant. Your pitch deck is protected with dynamic watermarks, screenshot protection, and granular access controls. You can revoke access instantly at any time.

list.question: How do I know which investors are most interested?
list.answer: DoQshare tracks detailed engagement metrics including view duration, pages viewed, and time spent on each slide. Investors who spend more time on your deck, view multiple slides, and return to view it again are typically more interested. Use these insights to prioritize your follow-ups.

list.question: Can I require investors to sign an NDA before viewing my pitch deck?
list.answer: Yes! DoQshare offers one-click NDA functionality. You can require viewers to accept an NDA before accessing your pitch deck, protecting your sensitive information and ensuring legal compliance.

list.question: What file formats are supported for pitch decks?
